units: Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵇ bot. (expl. לחשים, Is. III, 20) קדשייא דבר שהוא ניתן על בית הל׳ ear-rings, (namely) that which is put on the place where the whispering for charming purposes is done (the ear).—בל׳ in a low voice.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 3">Gen. R. s. 3</cite>, beg.; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:5:14">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵈ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="L00375"><he>לְחָשָׁא</he></cite>.].
Ab. II, 10 לְחִישָׁתָן לְחִישַׁת וכ׳ their (the scholars’) hissing is that of &c.; Num. R. s. 3, beg.—Trnsf. invidious talk, tale-bearing, insinuation.

<cite ref="Pesachim 57a:8">Pes. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>אוי לי מלחישתן</he> woe to me on account of their talk; <cite ref="Tosefta Menahot 13:21">Tosef. Men. XIII, 21</cite> <he>בית לחישתן</he> their mouth.—Pl. <he>לְחִישׁוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 14:3">Tosef. Sot. XIV, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Sotah 47b:18">Sot. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>לוחשי ל׳ בדין</he> those influencing the court by means of secret talk or insinuations.
